questionText: I had my hair ________ at a famous hair salon in Hanoi yesterday.
explanation: Cấu trúc thể cầu khiến bị động: S + have + sth + V(pp/V3) (nhờ/thuê ai làm gì). Động từ 'cut' có dạng phân từ 2 vẫn là 'cut'.
ruleTip: have + sth + V(pp): nhờ/thuê cái gì được làm.

questionText: My father got the mechanic ________ his motorbike before our long road trip.
explanation: Cấu trúc thể cầu khiến chủ động với GET: S + get + sb + to V(inf) (nhờ/thuyết phục ai làm việc gì). Ở đây tân ngữ chỉ người là 'the mechanic', do đó dùng 'to repair'.
ruleTip: get + sb (người) + to V: nhờ ai làm gì.

questionText: The teacher had the students ________ a 200-word paragraph about environmental protection.
explanation: Cấu trúc thể cầu khiến chủ động với HAVE: S + have + sb + V(bare-inf) (yêu cầu/giao cho ai làm gì). Sau tân ngữ chỉ người 'the students' dùng động từ nguyên thể không to 'write'.
ruleTip: have + sb (người) + V nguyên thể: yêu cầu/giao ai làm gì.

questionText: We are going to have our house ________ before the Lunar New Year holiday.
explanation: Cấu trúc thể cầu khiến bị động: have + sth + V(pp/V3). 'Our house' là tân ngữ chỉ vật nên theo sau là phân từ quá khứ 'redecorated'.
ruleTip: have + vật + V-ed/V3: ngôi nhà được sơn sửa/trang trí lại.

questionText: You should get your eyes ________ by an ophthalmologist once a year.
explanation: Cấu trúc cầu khiến bị động với GET: S + get + sth + V(pp/V3). 'Your eyes' là tân ngữ chỉ vật/bộ phận cơ thể, do đó dùng phân từ 2 'examined'.
ruleTip: get + sth + V(pp): kiểm tra mắt bởi bác sĩ chuyên khoa.

questionText:
Choose the sentence that is CLOSEST in meaning to the following sentence.

Workers installed an air conditioner in our classroom yesterday.

choices.text: We had an air conditioner installed in our classroom yesterday.
choices.html: We had an air conditioner installed in our classroom yesterday.

choices.text: We got an air conditioner to install in our classroom yesterday.
choices.html: We got an air conditioner to install in our classroom yesterday.

choices.text: We had installed an air conditioner by workers in our classroom yesterday.
choices.html: We had installed an air conditioner by workers in our classroom yesterday.

choices.text: We got workers installed an air conditioner in our classroom yesterday.
choices.html: We got workers installed an air conditioner in our classroom yesterday.

explanation: Chuyển đổi câu sang thể cầu khiến bị động: Thợ lắp đặt điều hòa cho lớp học -> Chúng tôi thuê/nhờ lắp điều hòa: S + had + sth (an air conditioner) + V(pp) (installed).
ruleTip: S + have + sth + V(pp): cấu trúc viết lại câu kinh điển trong thi vào 10.

questionText: Mr. Brown had his assistant ________ all the contracts before the board meeting started.
explanation: Cấu trúc: have + sb + V(bare). Tân ngữ là 'his assistant' (người) nên động từ theo sau là nguyên thể không 'to': 'photocopy'.
ruleTip: have + người + V nguyên mẫu: nhờ/giao trợ lý photo hợp đồng.

questionText: Can you help me get this heavy wardrobe ________ upstairs?
explanation: Cấu trúc: get + sth + V(pp/V3). 'This heavy wardrobe' (chiếc tủ quần áo nặng) là đồ vật được khiêng lên tầng, nên dùng quá khứ phân từ 'carried'.
ruleTip: get + vật + V(pp): cái tủ được khiêng lên gác.

questionText:
Choose the sentence that is CLOSEST in meaning to the following sentence.

A professional photographer will take our graduation photos.

choices.text: We will have our graduation photos taken by a professional photographer.
choices.html: We will have our graduation photos taken by a professional photographer.

choices.text: We will have taken our graduation photos by a professional photographer.
choices.html: We will have taken our graduation photos by a professional photographer.

choices.text: We will get a professional photographer taken our graduation photos.
choices.html: We will get a professional photographer taken our graduation photos.

choices.text: We will have our graduation photos to be taken by a photographer.
choices.html: We will have our graduation photos to be taken by a photographer.

explanation: Thì tương lai đơn dạng cầu khiến bị động: S + will have + sth (photos) + V(pp) (taken) + by sb.
ruleTip: will have + sth + taken: sẽ nhờ thợ chụp ảnh kỷ yếu.

questionText: Hoa finally managed to get her younger brother ________ all his vegetables during dinner.
explanation: Cấu trúc: get + sb + to V(inf): thuyết phục được ai làm việc gì. Tân ngữ 'her younger brother' là người, do đó cần 'to eat'.
ruleTip: get + người + to V: thuyết phục ai làm gì.

questionText: Lan had her bicycle ________ because the chain broke on her way to school.
explanation: Cấu trúc cầu khiến bị động: had + her bicycle (sth) + repaired (V_pp): sửa xe đạp.
ruleTip: have + vật + V(pp): xe đạp được đem đi sửa.

questionText: Don't worry! I will get my technician friend ________ a look at your faulty laptop.
explanation: Cấu trúc cầu khiến chủ động với GET: get + sb + to V(inf). 'My technician friend' là người -> dùng 'to take'.
ruleTip: get + người + to V: nhờ người bạn kỹ thuật viên xem giúp.

questionText: Did you have your dental check-up ________ at the central clinic?
explanation: Câu hỏi ở thể cầu khiến bị động: Did you have + sth (dental check-up) + V(pp) (done)?
ruleTip: have + sth + done: việc khám răng được thực hiện.

questionText:
Choose the sentence that is CLOSEST in meaning to the following sentence.

The dentist pulled out David's wisdom tooth this morning.

choices.text: David had his wisdom tooth pulled out by the dentist this morning.
choices.html: David had his wisdom tooth pulled out by the dentist this morning.

choices.text: David got the dentist pulled out his wisdom tooth this morning.
choices.html: David got the dentist pulled out his wisdom tooth this morning.

choices.text: David had pulled out his wisdom tooth by the dentist this morning.
choices.html: David had pulled out his wisdom tooth by the dentist this morning.

choices.text: David had the dentist to pull out his wisdom tooth this morning.
choices.html: David had the dentist to pull out his wisdom tooth this morning.

explanation: Bác sĩ nhổ răng khôn cho David -> David đi nhổ răng: David had his wisdom tooth pulled out by the dentist.
ruleTip: have + his tooth + pulled out: nhổ răng (thể cầu khiến).

questionText: We must have the water pipes ________ before the winter frost causes them to freeze and burst.
explanation: Cấu trúc thể cầu khiến bị động: must have + sth (the water pipes) + V(pp) (insulated): phải bọc cách nhiệt các đường ống nước.
ruleTip: have + sth + insulated: đường ống được bọc cách nhiệt.
